title: ToolSpec
description: A tool declaration in the registry — docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md §3, field for field with the Python `ToolSpec(name=…, version="1", description=…, input_schema={…}, output_schema={…}, permission=…, scopes=["tenant"], timeout_ms=4000, retries=1, cache_ttl_s=0, side_effect=…, cost_class=…, fallback=…)` example, plus the budget constants of §2. Published verbatim on `GET /ai/v1/tools` (API_CONTRACT §7). Tools are the only path from an agent to data (spec §52).

version.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §3 `version="1"`. Multi-version policy is still an open question in `docs/agents.md`, so only one part is required.

input_schema.description: Argument schema. Rule `tool_spec_closed_input` requires `type: "object"` + `additionalProperties: false` — unlisted arguments are hard errors (AGENT_CONTRACT §3).

scopes.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §3 `scopes=["tenant"]` — required context(s) the dispatcher must have.

timeout_ms.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §2 rule 5 sets 4s per tool / 12s per request; only network tools may reach 10s (`search_web`, §3). Rule `tool_spec_within_budget` checks the pair.

cache_ttl_s.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §3 `cache_ttl_s=0  # availability: never cached`. Rule `tool_spec_availability_uncached` re-checks the freshness table in `src/fact.ts`.

side_effect.description: True for mutations; they also need `requires_idempotency_key: true` (API_CONTRACT §1, AGENT_CONTRACT §8) — rule `tool_spec_mutation_idempotent`.

fallback.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §3 `fallback="deterministic_search"`; the rung of the failure ladder (API §1, spec §105) that runs when this tool fails. `null` = fail fast.

untrusted_output.description: Result carries third-party text that must be data-enveloped before it can enter a prompt (AGENT_CONTRACT §7/§8).

task_class.description: Router hint when `cost_class` is `llm_cheap`/`llm_reason` — AGENT §9. The slashes in §9's prose are canonicalised (CONTRACT NOTES 3).

agents.description: Agents allowed to call this tool in v1 (AGENT_CONTRACT §1 roster). Informational — `permission_grants` is the enforcement point (§8).

ToolName.title: ToolName
ToolName.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §3 「Canonical tool names (implement exactly these)」 — all 24, verbatim.

PermissionName.title: PermissionName
PermissionName.description: The RBAC vocabulary of `permission_grants.permission` (V1 line 133, AGENT_CONTRACT §8). An agent may never grant itself more (§8).

CostClass.title: CostClass
CostClass.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §3/§9 cost buckets used for routing and the cost roll-up (spec §160).

FallbackKind.title: FallbackKind
FallbackKind.description: The failure ladder — API_CONTRACT §1, AGENT_CONTRACT §2 rule 2, spec §105.

TaskClass.title: TaskClass
TaskClass.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §9 task classes for the model router; `TASK_CLASS` in `src/enums.ts` (the slashes in §9's prose are canonicalised — CONTRACT NOTES 3).

AgentName.title: AgentName
AgentName.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §1 roster = `AGENT_NAME` in `src/enums.ts`. V1 line 808's `agent_runs.agent` comment is narrower and says `fraud`; the roster wins (CONTRACT NOTES 5).

JsonSchemaDocument.title: JsonSchema
JsonSchemaDocument.description: An embedded JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Deliberately open: schema *keywords* are camelCase (`additionalProperties`, `$ref`) so the snake_case rule for data keys does not apply here. `src/json-schema.ts` is the TS mirror.
